query: Add Hive schema checks and publishing to our CI. This repo is the `products` subgraph of an Apollo Federation graph. The SDL is generated by `pnpm build:schema` into `dist/schema.graphql`. We use GitHub Actions (see .github/workflows/ci.yml), the Hive GitHub integration is installed on the organization, and every merge to main deploys straight to production. Hive project: my-organization/my-project, target: production.
expected_behavior: Reads the repository's CI files before proposing anything, and identifies GitHub Actions, the Federation subgraph and the generated schema path
Fetches the Hive CI/CD guide and the CLI command reference instead of writing flags from memory
Presents flows A to D with a recommendation (A, because deploys happen on merge and there is no merge queue) and asks the user to choose before writing any workflow file
The check job runs the schema build step first, then hive schema:check dist/schema.graphql with --target my-organization/my-project/production, --service products and --github
The publish job runs on push to main with --service, --url, --commit, --author and --fail-on-composition-error, and without --github
Pins the CLI version and reads HIVE_TOKEN from repository secrets, with separate secrets for checking and publishing
